project_context.app_type: SaaS Dashboard / Business Management Internal Tool
project_context.target_audience: Freelancer managing digital marketing & messaging services clients

theme_strategy: Light mode primary (crucial for PDF generation of invoices/quotes), orange-and-white SaaS identity with 'Calm Density'. Emphasize typographic hierarchy over heavy container boxes.
archetype: Modern SaaS, warm accent on neutral canvas

headings.rules: Must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Keep hierarchy strict (e.g., H1 text-4xl, H2 text-2xl).

body.rules: Use 'tabular-nums' utility for ALL tables, invoices, currency amounts, and numerical data.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid crisp borders (border-border) everywhere. No soft drop-shadows on standard cards.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness, max 8px (rounded-md). Avoid full pill shapes except for status badges.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders ('Technical Look') - expose the skeleton, use border-collapse styles for dense data tables.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Dense and compact (p-4 to p-6) for dashboard widgets. Generous spacing (p-8 to p-12) for outer page containers.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only use for sticky elements (e.g., backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b).

layouts.navigation: Collapsible left sidebar for global navigation. Top bar for user profile and global actions.
layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4). Span summary cards 1 col, main charts 2-3 cols.
layouts.tables: Tables are back: use dense tables with sticky headers for Invoices, Customers, Credit Logs.
layouts.forms: Use multi-column layouts for wide forms (Customer creation). For invoices, use a clear Line Items table with dynamic add/remove.

motion.interactions: Hover states must explicitly set text and background color. Slight lift (-translate-y-1) for actionable cards.
motion.page_transitions: Staggered fade-in for table rows or dashboard widgets using framer-motion.

specific_instructions.cards: Go cardless where possible, or use flat rectangular shapes with 1px border. Strip out default Shadcn shadows.
specific_instructions.tables: Must use tabular numbers. Align financial columns right. Add hover state per row. Include pagination.
specific_instructions.forms: Never use native <input>. Heavily customize Shadcn Form components.
specific_instructions.toasts: sonner (located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or .js depending on install)
specific_instructions.badges: Use sharp or slightly rounded badges for statuses (Draft, Sent, Paid, Overdue).

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight. Keep sizes consistent (18px - 20px). Do not use Emojis as icons.

image_urls.description: Curved white architectural ribs creating a rhythmic pattern. Use as the right-side visual on a 50/50 split login screen.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA standards or WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text). Focus states must have higher contrast.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='invoice-total').

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize 'calm density'. The application is data-heavy (invoices, credits, payments). Use space efficiently without feeling cluttered.
Implement dynamic form fields for Invoice and Quotation line items.
Provide PDF generation/print styling capability for Invoices and Quotations. Design the invoice view to look print-ready.
Ensure global search functions across the dense datasets.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for any surfaces with content underneath.
Always add explicit hover states for every interactive element.
Remember the app name is 'SANJU ANIMATIONS IT SOLUTIONS' and currency is INR (₹). Use proper formatting (e.g., ₹ 1,50,000).
For the Profit Overview module, use Recharts to compare sales vs credit purchase cost.
You have .js files not .tsx file, so write components in JavaScript (.js or .jsx) with prop-types if necessary, instead of TypeScript.
Create a Services catalog logic with default prices and descriptions.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) selectively.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (sharp or rounded-md) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Check them before building from scratch.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
